answer: Sybils splitting identities face multiplied bond costs, while honest participants recover stake via a shared garden of reputation records. Each agent must stake a bond proportional to its claimed compute, verified through random proof-of-work challenges. Colluders who fake work are slashed, and their stake flows to a lagoon reserve funding audits, turning attack attempts into an oasis of rewards for honest verifiers. From sa0028's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
